lineage_records.title: SimICT: A Fast and Flexible Framework for Performance and Power Evaluation of Large-Scale Architecture
lineage_records.simulator: Component-based parallel framework; later team papers explicitly use it for cycle-accurate DPU models.
lineage_records.implementation: Performance/power models are integrated as configurable components; source repository not found.
lineage_records.relationship: MLX's simulator citation [36] resolves to SimICT; this supports framework ancestry, not code identity.

lineage_records.title: BDSim: A Component-Based Highly Configurable Parallel Simulation Framework for Big-Data Application Evaluation
lineage_records.simulator: Same-team componentized parallel simulation publication for many-core/big-data evaluation.
lineage_records.implementation: Bibliographic primary evidence only; no public code or MLX citation identified.
lineage_records.relationship: Possible infrastructure precedent, weaker than the explicit SimICT citation.

lineage_records.title: An Efficient Network-on-Chip Router for Dataflow Architecture
lineage_records.implementation: Multiple-destination, high-injection, latency-sensitive non-flit NoC design.
lineage_records.relationship: Establishes the ICT DPU PE-array/NoC line that predates MLX.

lineage_records.title: A Pipelining Loop Optimization Method for Dataflow Architecture
lineage_records.simulator: SimICT dataflow accelerator model with an 8x8 PE array and SPM.
lineage_records.implementation: Loop controller/instructions raise ready work and pipeline utilization.
lineage_records.relationship: Precedent for MLX loop-driven tagged templates, without MLX tags or CDCs.

lineage_records.title: A Non-Stop Double Buffering Mechanism for Dataflow Architecture
lineage_records.simulator: SimICT model exposes instruction buffers and multiple blocks in flight.
lineage_records.implementation: Non-stop double buffering avoids repeated array fill/drain across tiles.
lineage_records.relationship: Directly relevant to MLX data-supply and folded execution timing.

lineage_records.title: Optimum Research on Inner-Instruction Memory Access Conflict for Dataflow Architecture
lineage_records.simulator: SimICT hosts a 1 GHz 4x4 dataflow array with ARM host, SPM, operand RAM and two 64-bit XY NoCs.
lineage_records.implementation: A matching Verilog implementation is synthesized in a foundry process for area/power.
lineage_records.relationship: Strong public predecessor for MLX's compact reduced design, but not an explicit parent statement.

lineage_records.title: Accelerating Data Transfer in Dataflow Architectures Through a Look-Ahead Acknowledgment Mechanism
lineage_records.simulator: Cycle-accurate SimICT model calibrated against gem5; host derives from SimpleScalar.
lineage_records.implementation: 4x4 array, heterogeneous FUs, instruction buffers, SPM and multiple mesh networks.
lineage_records.relationship: Strong evidence for the simulator methodology and transfer subsystem inherited by later DFUs.

lineage_records.title: Improving Utilization of Dataflow Unit for Multi-Batch Processing
lineage_records.simulator: Public metadata does not name the simulator; it belongs to the same DPU evaluation line.
lineage_records.implementation: Unified scale-vector modes, reconfigurable clusters, DFG-node pipeline stages and task model.
lineage_records.relationship: High-specificity conceptual predecessor to M2-DFU's multi-mode architecture.

lineage_records.title: DFU-E: A Dataflow Architecture for Edge DSP and AI Applications
lineage_records.simulator: Full text unavailable in the frozen sources; exact simulator configuration remains unreported.
lineage_records.implementation: Multi-layer task/block/instruction/data parallelism, customized PE/memory/NoC and software stack.
lineage_records.relationship: Very strong architecture-family candidate with extensive MLX author overlap; no explicit derivation link.

lineage_records.title: PANDA: Adaptive Prefetching and Decentralized Scheduling for Dataflow Architectures
lineage_records.simulator: Simulator name is not present in retained primary metadata.
lineage_records.implementation: Adaptive prefetch/on-chip memory plus decentralized PE scheduling.
lineage_records.relationship: Likely relevant to MLX memory backpressure; not a parent claim.

lineage_records.title: DFGAS: Exploring the Balance of HW-SW Scheduling through the DFG-Aware Scheme
lineage_records.simulator: Publisher full text is unavailable; no source-qualified simulator name recovered.
lineage_records.implementation: DFG-aware hardware/software scheduling in the same DFU line.
lineage_records.relationship: Likely scheduling ancestry, but not an explicit MLX fork or parent.

lineage_records.title: M2-DFU: Multi-Mode Dataflow Architecture for Adaptive and High-Efficiency Data Processing
lineage_records.simulator: Just-accepted record has no accessible full text or simulator disclosure.
lineage_records.implementation: Official author records identify a general multi-mode DFU with the core MLX hardware authors.
lineage_records.relationship: Best title/chronology/author match for MLX's unnamed general-purpose design, but explicit lineage remains absent.

lineage_records.title: SmarCo Processor Architecture Group engineering disclosure
lineage_records.simulator: Official personal page names PE, on-chip memory and data-transfer simulator optimization.
lineage_records.implementation: Same group reports SPM/cache RTL and runtime scheduling; DPU-s/HTC-3000/HTC-3500 chips are listed.
lineage_records.relationship: Strong evidence that the current DFU simulator/RTL/runtime stack is internal to ICT/Ricore/SmarCo.

lineage_records.title: Debugging Method and Device for a Coarse-Grained Dataflow Execution Array
lineage_records.simulator: Patent is hardware debug rather than performance simulation.
lineage_records.implementation: PE array executes program blocks identified by task ID, block ID and repeated instance.
lineage_records.relationship: Precedent for MLX block/tag/instance state, without proving shared RTL.

lineage_records.title: DSAGEN / OverGen / Assassyn full-stack spatial-accelerator line
lineage_records.simulator: DSAGEN supplies gem5 timing; Assassyn unifies asynchronous simulation and RTL.
lineage_records.implementation: Public compiler, generation and simulation methods from MLX coauthor Jian Weng.
lineage_records.relationship: Best open second-development reference, but no primary evidence that ICT's MLX simulator forks it.

basis: same institution and commercial chip line
MLX simulator citation resolves to SimICT
team DPU papers repeatedly use cycle-accurate SimICT
historical calibration against gem5 and RTL
MLX coauthor's public spatial compiler/simulation stack

conclusions.best_open_second_development_substrate: gem5 component model plus DSAGEN/Assassyn mechanisms and Accel-Sim GPU baselines
